> # IEA Iron and Steel Technology Roadmap — evidence excerpt
>
> Source: https://www.iea.org/reports/iron-and-steel-technology-roadmap
>
> Published: 2020-10-08
>
> Collected: 2026-07-25
>
> ## Verified statements
>
> - IEA distinguishes fully electrolytic-hydrogen DRI-EAF from commercial
>   natural-gas and coal DRI routes.
> - In the Sustainable Development Scenario, access to renewable electricity at
>   USD 20–30/MWh gives hydrogen DRI a regional competitive advantage and the
>   route reaches just under 15% of global primary steel production in 2050.
> - The scenario requires roughly one hydrogen DRI plant to be deployed each
>   month after market introduction.
> - Electrolytic hydrogen for steel raises electricity demand by about 720 TWh
>   in 2050, equivalent to around 60% of the steel sector's electricity use at
>   the report's baseline.
> - IEA stresses that hydrogen transport, storage, generation and power
>   infrastructure must be built alongside steel plants.
>
> These are scenario results, not forecasts or plant-level performance
> guarantees.
